tasks_completed.description: Forwarded Codex raw wrapper thread/turn identity and gated root lifecycle completion.
tasks_completed.rationale: The BA root cause identified missing wrapper threadId/turnId and ungated child final_answer completion. The app-server now forwards wrapper identity across command/file/tool/plan/image/agent events, remembers receiver child thread ids, and only emits root task completion for root/current-thread final answers or lifecycle completions. Child final answers no longer create top-level task_complete, top-level turn-end, or clear parent linkage.

tasks_completed.description: Mapped Codex command results and spawn-agent identity into Claude-equivalent session protocol events.
tasks_completed.rationale: Codex exec_command_end now produces structured Bash result fields while retaining legacy output. Only learned receiver thread ids become CUID2 subagent identities, spawnAgent call/input/subagent ids are linked consistently, and child final answers attach as child content/results without closing the root turn.

tasks_completed.description: Extended wire/app normalization for structured tool results without weakening CUID subagent guards.
tasks_completed.rationale: The BA required Bash ToolCall.result to carry output/status/exit/failure/empty-output fields. Wire and app schemas now accept optional structured tool-end results and the app normalizer preserves them for rendering while existing non-CUID subagent rejection remains covered by tests.

tasks_completed.description: Verified reducer/sidebar sidechain linkage for Codex spawn-agent and provider-neutral child rendering.
tasks_completed.rationale: Added/kept tests showing functions.spawn_agent sidechain linkage uses the generated sessionSubagent CUID2 rather than raw provider thread ids. Sidebar routing now treats functions.spawn_agent like Claude Agent/Task and renders child tools/text in the agent conversation.

tasks_completed.description: Added/shared Codex terminal and auxiliary rendering helpers for Claude Code parity.
tasks_completed.rationale: Codex Bash output now renders from structured result data with command/status/stdout/stderr previews, and plan/image/file tool families have registered views for child content carried through the normalized protocol.

tasks_completed.description: Resolved QA iteration findings for declined command coverage and CodexPlanView theme usage.
tasks_completed.changes: Added declined-status Codex command expectations across mapper/schema/normalizer/render-helper tests and replaced CodexPlanView hardcoded blue with theme.colors.status.connecting.
tasks_completed.rationale: QA found AC1 lacked explicit declined command coverage and CodexPlanView deviated from theme-token styling. These changes satisfy the QA findings while preserving the previous L4 transport/linkage implementation.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Not a single bisected regression; related prior commits include dd963663, 0ba2ddfc, 4381eaf5, and 5c7a234f.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Prior Codex rendering activation and Claude Agent/Task rendering improvements did not make Claude's normalized transcript data-flow a strict Codex transport contract. Codex command results, wrapper thread attribution, receiver-thread identity, and root-vs-child lifecycle boundaries were lost before UI rendering.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: The fix keeps provider-specific normalization at the Codex CLI/protocol boundary, forwards structured command and child-thread data through wire/app schemas, and leaves UI rendering keyed to provider-neutral ToolCall/result/sidechain contracts.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: The BA-approved L4 fix spans app-server raw Codex protocol normalization, session-protocol mapping, wire/app schemas, reducer sidechain behavior, sidebar/tool rendering, and golden regression tests. The scoped stats include issue-relevant preserved WIP in an already-dirty worktree plus new coverage needed to prevent child final-answer lifecycle regressions.
